user.title: Connect to Coinbase
user.description: Enter your Coinbase Developer Platform (CDP) API key credentials. Create a key at [Coinbase Developer Platform](https://portal.cdp.coinbase.com/access/api).

data_description.api_key_name: The key name in the format `organizations/{org-id}/apiKeys/{key-id}`.
data_description.api_private_key: The EC private key PEM block from the CDP portal. Paste the full PEM including `-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----` and `-----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----`.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Coinbase Wallet
reconfigure.description: Update your CDP API credentials. Leave the private key blank to keep the current value.

data.api_private_key: Private key (leave blank to keep current)
data.name: Account name

error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach the Coinbase API. Check network connectivity.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Verify your API key name and private key.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Coinbase API key is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll Coinbase for updated balances and transactions. Minimum 300 s. Default is 3600 s (1 h).

auth_failed.title: Coinbase authentication failed for {account_name}
auth_failed.description:
Home Assistant could not authenticate to Coinbase for **{account_name}**.

Your CDP API key may have been revoked or expired. Go to the [Coinbase Developer Platform](https://portal.cdp.coinbase.com/access/api), create a new key, then use **Reconfigure** to update the credentials.

cannot_connect.title: Cannot reach Coinbase API for {account_name}
cannot_connect.description:
Home Assistant failed to connect to the Coinbase API for **{account_name}**.

Check network connectivity, then go to **Settings → Devices & services → {account_name}** and select **Reload**.
